tally_rule: The public tally counts `adjusted` (the headline). `base` is the backtested model and is scored alongside it. v1 only: later versions are shown but never swapped in. A later (v2) refresh of this match, if any, is labelled and never replaces this file.

sanity.note: Our Elo runs on a closed pool from 1500 (3 seasons), so only differences are comparable. Display only: no model value was changed after the lock.
